race.description: Pinker Pinker Tickets On Sale Now 9 Oct Hcp (Bm62)
race.comment: Open staying race. OMAMORI (1) is racing consistently this time in without winning, the past two in town. Two back he was fourth to Nearco Frod who has since won in better company and last time behind the in-form Shultzy. This suits from an ideal draw. BATOKA CHIEF (6) is going quite well and did narrowly beat OMAMORI home last time when they clashed. He maps nicely as well and should be right there. THREE REEL ROSES (11) is coming off a solid win at Moe in similar company and can measure up. PRESSURISED (5) was good at huge odds last time in handy 3yo company at Caulfield. A repeat of that has him in the finish. AMAWASHA (7) got home well behind THREE REEL ROSES last start and is in the minor mix again.
